planets.name: TOI-251 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-251 with a 4.94-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-251 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-251. Its orbit and size follow Zhou et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
